reviews.title: The absolute worst
reviews.text:
This is the worst app I’ve ever used for this type of service.

Downloaded it on my commute thinking I’d get ahead of the notoriously slow line - only to have it completely brick my phone. Had to Google how to reset a frozen phone once I got to my office. Truly a great start.

Later that day, gave it a second chance. The interface is an absolute disaster - wall-to-wall magazine shoot photos when all you want is to find the coffee. The menu is a horizontal scroll bar with no “Coffee” label anywhere. You click Iced Drinks - nope, that’s $10 fruity specialty drinks. You scroll all the way down and eventually find actual coffee buried at the bottom.

Then you notice the prices are higher than ordering in person. HIGHER. At Maman.

You decide to order anyway - at least you can skip the line. You survive the whole ordeal, fill your cart, and then it asks you to select a pickup time. Not 5 minutes. Not 10. TWENTY MINUTES. (I think it was actually 40 but I’m a kind person.)

Lucky for them they’re the only coffee shop near my office. They still got my business. But not because of this app. Despite it.

reviews.text: Terrible app. Scan for Loyalty doesn’t work, you need to scan with the payment. Your app keeps telling me I have rewards and then when i open the app there’s nothing! the bait and switch just pisses me off more because you’re clearly clamoring for me to use the app again. before this lunchbox nonsense the maman app was great! the rewards are great! you guys only get my business because it’s the closest coffee shop to my workplace but TRUST i only go as a last resort.
